stories.title: Weight Configuration Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define canonical schema for user-adjustable weights including measure_id, weight_value, normalization rules, and optional user/session identifier. Establish contract between frontend and backend for weight submission and persistence.
stories.evidence: GAP: No weighting or preference persistence system exists in frontend or backend

stories.title: Weighted Scoring Engine Extension
stories.description: Extend provider and clinical trial scoring engines to accept dynamic weight inputs and recompute composite scores deterministically while preserving existing scoring logic as default behavior.

stories.title: Weights API and Persistence Layer
stories.description: Implement backend API endpoints to accept, validate, and optionally persist user weight configurations (session-based or stored). Ensure integration with scoring facade to trigger recalculation on demand.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py; GAP: No existing preference persistence or weights API

stories.title: Frontend Weight Adjustment UI
stories.description: Build UI controls allowing users to adjust importance of quality measures (e.g., sliders or toggles) and trigger score recalculation. Integrate with existing chat or results display components.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx; GAP: No UI for structured weight adjustment exists

stories.title: End-to-End Weighting Tests and Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating schema enforcement, scoring recalculation accuracy, API behavior, and UI-triggered updates across provider and clinical trial flows.
